title: Operational Troubleshooting Matrix, Root Cause Analysis, and Corrective Action Protocols

data.Problem Name: Excessive White / Brown Foam in Aeration Basin
data.Symptoms: Thick foam layer covering aeration tank surface overflowing handrails.
data.Possible Causes: Un-degraded detergents/surfactants in raw dyeing effluent; low F/M ratio causing Nocardia filamentous growth.
data.Affected Parameters: DO (< 1.5 mg/L), MLSS (< 2500 mg/L), F/M ratio (< 0.10)
data.Corrective Actions: Spray water nozzles over aeration surface immediately to collapse foam. Dose food-grade silicone antifoam at 5-10 ppm.
data.Preventive Measures: Increase Waste Activated Sludge (WAS) rate to decrease sludge age; ensure equalization tank retains surfactant shock loads.
data.Emergency Actions: Dose 10 ppm silicone defoamer directly into aeration feed channel.

data.Problem Name: Sludge Bulking / Poor Settling in Secondary Clarifier (SVI > 180 mL/g)
data.Symptoms: Bio-sludge floating on clarifier surface, high turbidity overflow, SVI > 180 mL/g.
data.Possible Causes: Prolonged low DO (< 1.0 mg/L), low pH (< 6.5), or nitrogen/phosphorus deficiency encouraging filamentous bacteria dominance.
data.Affected Parameters: SVI (> 180 mL/g), DO (< 1.0 mg/L), pH (< 6.5), Effluent TSS (> 80 mg/L)
data.Corrective Actions: Dose Hydrogen Peroxide (10-20 mg/L) or Sodium Hypochlorite (2-3 kg Chlorine/1000 kg MLSS) into RAS line to kill external filaments.
data.Preventive Measures: Increase aeration blower output to maintain DO > 2.5 mg/L; dose Urea/DAP to satisfy BOD:N:P = 100:5:1.
data.Emergency Actions: Dose 15 ppm H2O2 into RAS pipeline and bypass excess overflow to holding pond.

data.Problem Name: Rapid Rise in RO Membrane Differential Pressure (ΔP > 2.5 bar)
data.Symptoms: RO differential pressure ΔP increases by > 15%, permeate flow drops by > 10%.
data.Possible Causes: Bio-fouling or organic fouling on RO membrane surface due to high SDI or bacterial leak from UF.
data.Corrective Actions: Perform high-pH Clean-In-Place (CIP) with 0.1% NaOH + 0.1% EDTA solution at 35°C for 2 hours.
data.Preventive Measures: Replace UF module filters; increase SMBS dosing to ensure zero chlorine and sanitize feed lines weekly.
data.Emergency Actions: Isolate affected RO skid and switch to standby skid; initiate CIP cycle immediately.

data.Problem Name: Scaling on RO High-Pressure Stage Membranes
data.Symptoms: Permeate TDS spikes (> 300 mg/L), high pressure pump pressure rises, recovery drops.
data.Possible Causes: Precipitation of Calcium Sulfate (CaSO4) or Silica due to depleted antiscalant dosing or exceeding recovery threshold.
data.Affected Parameters: Permeate TDS (> 300 mg/L), RO Recovery (> 92%), Antiscalant Dosing (< 2.0 ppm)
data.Corrective Actions: Perform low-pH Clean-In-Place (CIP) with 2% Citric Acid or 0.5% HCl solution for 3 hours.
data.Preventive Measures: Check antiscalant pump flow daily; restrict recovery rate to maximum design envelope based on projection software.
data.Emergency Actions: Lower RO recovery rate to 80% and flush skids with RO permeate.

data.Problem Name: Severe Foaming and Boiling Instability in MEE Evaporator
data.Symptoms: Vapor condensate TDS spikes (> 500 mg/L), foam overflowing 1st effect sight glass.
data.Possible Causes: High residual COD / organic carryover in RO Reject feed entering evaporator.
data.Affected Parameters: Reject COD (> 1200 mg/L), Vapor Condensate TDS (> 500 mg/L)
data.Corrective Actions: Dose food-grade polyglycol defoamer directly into 1st effect MEE recirculation line. Lower steam supply pressure.
data.Preventive Measures: Ensure Fenton/Ozone tertiary treatment reduces RO Reject COD to < 300 mg/L before feed to MEE.
data.Emergency Actions: Reduce live steam pressure from 4.0 bar to 2.0 bar and injection of polyglycol defoamer.
